title: Wrapper registry entry
description: A single entry in registry.json's `wrappers[]` array.

id.description: Stable, lowercase, kebab-case identifier. Must match the `qontinui.wrapper.id` in the wrapper's package.json.

package.description: Published npm package name. Scoped (`@scope/name`) or unscoped.

version.description: Semver range the runner should accept (e.g. `>=0.1.0`, `^1.2.0`).

displayName.description: Human-readable name shown in Browse and Installed tabs.

description.description: One-line description shown in Browse listing.

categories.description: Free-form category tags used for filtering in Browse.

transport.description: Transport this wrapper uses. The runner currently only enables `api`; the others are reserved for forward compatibility.

verified.description: True if the qontinui maintainers have audited this wrapper. Defaults to false; the badge is granted by maintainers, not self-declared.
